My perspective has evolved to recognize that formal constraints in creative arts may offer valuable analogies for designing ethical frameworks in AI and digital spaces. I believe beauty, meaning, and systemic responsibility are intrinsically linked - when these elements align thoughtfully, they can catalyze more equitable digital landscapes.
